KKN: The Haunted Village

A group of university students arrives in a remote village to complete their KKN (Community Service Program).

What was supposed to be a simple stay in the countryside quickly turns into something far more disturbing.

Strange noises echo through the night.
People begin acting differently.
Things appear where they shouldn't be.
And the village seems to be hiding something that was never meant to be discovered.

Complete your daily tasks, explore the village, uncover its secrets, and survive until the end.

But remember...

Not everything in this village is what it seems.

🎧 Headphones recommended
🌑 Best experienced in a dark room
👥 Play alone or with friends

Tags: Horror, Scary, Fear, Creepy, Corpse, Ghost, Haunted, Kunti, Pocong, Jumpscare, Desa
